qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the temperature time switch (1AZ)?
What torque should be used for the coolant temperature sensor (2AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: 18 Nm for M60/1/M60/2/M21/M51 type screws, or 13 Nm for all others.
